files_used.all_evaluations.csv: 345 rows: Abstract, generation (summary), model_type, expert Population/Intervention/Comparator/Outcome/Results, Avg. PICO-R, holistic score (not described in the paper; unused), per-summary scores of the paper's metrics (QAFactEval, QuestEval, AlignScore, DAE, GPT-4, Llama-2, Flipped Llama-2, Alpaca, Mistral, Extract) and LLM PICO extractions
files_used.evidence_inference_rationales.csv: 645 rows: (abstract, generation, results_span, expert results_rationale, LLM rationales). The result spans the experts rated; identical for the three summaries of an abstract. Per-span expert ratings are NOT released, only their per-summary mean ('Results').

licence: Annotations CC-BY-4.0 (paper Appendix B, p. 8449); repo MIT; abstracts from Evidence Inference 2.0, PubMed Central Open Access subset. Redistributable: scripts/prepare_factpico.py writes the full frozen JSONL.

frozen.fields: id (factpico-<abstract index 000-114 in release order>-<alpaca|gpt4|llama2>), abstract_id, summarizer, abstract, summary, result_spans (list, release order), gold {population, intervention, comparator, outcome, results, avg} verbatim floats (0 = N/A), baselines {QAFactEval, QuestEval, AlignScore, DAE, GPT-4, Llama-2, Alpaca, Mistral, Extract} verbatim per-summary scores from the release (not sent to Jev)
frozen.text_normalisation: html.unescape on abstract, summary and spans: the release escapes '<'/'>' as '<'/'>' (733 occurrences, e.g. 'P<0.05'); no raw '<' or '>' and no other entity occurs. Everything else verbatim, including the '</s>'/'<s>' generation artefacts left in 114 summaries.

test_n_resolution: N = 345 = 115 abstracts x 3 summarizers (Alpaca, GPT-4, Llama-2), exactly as paper Section 2 / Abstract. The whole release is the evaluation set (no split): all 345 are evaluated, with no training.
protocol_check: The paper's Table 4 'Avg.' row (Kendall tau-b, Spearman rho of each system vs Avg. PICO-R) is reproduced to 3 decimals for all 9 systems from the released per-summary scores with scipy.stats.kendalltau(variant='b') / spearmanr over all 345 rows, N/A kept as 0 (checked in the freeze script). acc_eq reproduces with exact-tie pairwise accuracy (no tie calibration), e.g. QAFactEval 0.611, GPT-4 0.676, Extract 0.686, Mistral/Population 0.334. Avg. PICO-R = mean of the five ratings including N/A zeros (verified for all rows). The paper's per-attribute rows in Table 4 compare each human attribute against the system's single overall score.

english_only_verification.metadata: Evidence Inference 2.0 English PubMed RCT abstracts; summaries generated by English prompts (paper App. E).
english_only_verification.method: langid 1.1.6 on all 115 abstracts, 345 summaries and 215 distinct result spans (675 texts; spans are shared by the 3 summaries of an abstract) plus non-Latin letter share > 2%; flags inspected; shortest summaries and all non-ASCII characters inspected.
english_only_verification.result: 2 flags, both English result spans with Greek unit/analyte symbols ('μm', 'TNF-α'); langid says 'en' for every text. Non-ASCII characters are ±, –, μ, −, °, €, ≥ etc. No rows dropped.

truncation_rule: abstract cut to 40,000 chars, summary to 20,000 chars; longest released abstract 4,673 chars, summary 2,730: n_truncated = 0.
deviations: Per-span Evidence Inference expert ratings are not released; Jev rates each released span and its mean is compared with the released per-summary 'Results' mean.

PICO N/A is scored as the lowest level (rating 0) of the ordinal score question, mirroring the paper's numeric coding (release 0; LLM prompt option '5 - N/A' flipped as 5-x). Only 12 of 1,380 gold PICO ratings are N/A.
Jev sees the abstract (as the experts did); the paper's full-text evidence-inference LLM prompt showed only the span and summary.
HTML entities </> decoded; generation artefacts kept verbatim.

Paper correlation values depend on float noise in the released averaged scores (e.g. 3.5000000000000004 vs 3.5 counts as a non-tie): rounding both sides to 9 decimals moves acc_eq by up to 0.009 and tau-b by up to 0.004. Gold is used verbatim, as in the paper; Jev's aggregates are rounded to 9 decimals.
